placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Brandon Hill offers a green break close to central Bristol. Its sloping lawns and nature area create a quieter setting for lunch, with the city still visible around you.

Our family idea: find a comfortable patch of grass, then take turns identifying buildings in the view. Keep the climb and the picnic as your main plan rather than relying on entering Cabot Tower.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families happy to walk uphill for a picnic with a view.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Play area, nature park and toilets near Cabot Tower.
placepracticalinfo.parking: There is no dedicated car park; plan city-centre parking or public transport.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Paths and lawns are steep in places. Cabot Tower is listed as temporarily closed for maintenance; check the council page for updates.

placevisitmap.travelNote: There is no dedicated car park; plan city-centre parking or public transport. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
